speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your symptoms. To better understand the nature of your sudden-onset vertigo, have you experienced any hearing loss, tinnitus, or a feeling of fullness in your ear?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). Given the sudden onset lasting only 3 minutes while in bed, without hearing loss or neurological deficits, BPPV is the most likely cause.
